artboards.title: Today · a stop with a note
Planner · a stop selected, two drags in flight

annotations.text: Three ways to shape the day list. A is what the app screens are built on, because it is what you described. B and C are here so you can see what you are giving up. They are sketches, not proposals - say the word and I will build one out properly.

THE WAY IN

Sign in · Trips · New trip · a brand new trip · Today once it has stops.

No hamburger and no kebab. The chevron beside the trip name is the only menu: Map view, Plan view, then Back to trips. Its artboard is eighth along.

The one thing beside it is the invite control at the end of the avatar stack, which is how you reach People without the nav growing a second menu.

Every phone artboard is 375 x 667: a small phone with the browser's own chrome already taken off.

STATES THAT WERE MISSING

Empty trip: no pins, no stops, and two ways out. Everything else on this canvas assumed a full trip.

No connection: the app keeps working. A strip says so and counts what is waiting, a change made offline carries a clock, and something added offline is dashed until it is shared. Last writer still wins on reconnect, with nothing shown - decided, not overlooked.

PLANNER · DESKTOP

Click an empty cell and search opens there, scoped to that day and hour. Click an event for Edit, Add note, Delete. The plus at each end of the grid extends the trip by a day.

Cards now carry the author avatar the phone cards have.

PLANNER · SELECTION AND DRAG

Two drags at once, which would not happen in life but shows both halves. On Sat Oct 3 an event already on the grid moves up its own day, leaving a dashed ghost. On Mon Oct 5 an item is dragged in from To be planned, its sidebar row dashed out until it lands.

PLAN VIEW ON A PHONE · IN V1

A seven-column grid cannot work at 375px, so this is one day per screen with the time running down and the gaps drawn to scale. Days swipe on the pill rail.

The tray along the bottom is the real reason it earns its place: To be planned has no good home anywhere else on a phone, and here it sits under the day you are filling, ready to drag up.
